seed_ledger.name: Evanston power station (gas supply)
seed_ledger.reason: NOT_FOUND: no source names a supply lateral, length or operator for the Prometheus Evanston campus. Sources say PureWest is the preferred gas supplier and a company listing mentions gas pipelines on both sides, and the site is about 2.6 km from the MountainWest main line (P6898). The June 2026 county permit coverage describes an islanded microgrid on Wyoming gas and names no pipe. Searches run: 10. Checked: DCD and KPCW and WyoFile coverage (no pipe named); Cowboy State Daily Aug 2026 letter (no pipe); FERC prior notice and Federal Register query (nothing for Evanston); Wyoming air permit query (no permit found); Kern River and MountainWest lateral queries (only unrelated Delta Lateral); EIA workbook not hit; Uinta County permit coverage (no pipeline detail).

evidence.note: May 2025 DCD: PureWest gas supplier, 150 MW growing to 1,200 MW, gas pipelines on both sides per company listing; no route
June 2026: county conditional use permit, islanded gas microgrid, no pipeline named

seed_ledger.name: Frontier Carbon power station (gas supply)
seed_ledger.reason: NOT_FOUND: not dropped on reconsideration. Frontier Carbon Solutions is the carbon removal partner at Granger, but its sister Frontier Infrastructure ordered Baker Hughes NovaLT turbines (270 MW, Wyoming and Texas) for behind-the-meter data center islands, so a gas-fired site may exist. No source gives the site, the gas supply or any pipe. Searches run: 8. Checked: WyoFile and DCD (carbon storage hub near Granger, no pipe); Baker Hughes and DCD turbine releases (sites undisclosed); Cowboy State Daily Aug 2026 (no Frontier mention); S&P and energytech coverage (no pipe); FERC and Wyoming permit queries (nothing).

evidence.note: Frontier role in Prometheus deal, storage hub near Granger
